title: P0 multilingual comprehension validation
rawUserRequest: 查收，执行计划。我授权给你，并写入Contract。

declaredIntent.requestedOutcome: Run and record bounded English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese P0 comprehension protocol evidence without overclaiming native editorial quality.

outOfScope: Runtime behavior, release metadata, and publication.
Claiming native-language editorial quality without an independent native-language reviewer.

sources.reason: WI-6 protocol, threshold, and failure rules.
Canonical core narrative and reader route.
P0 topic ownership and locale paths.

riskAssessment.reason: A comprehension claim can hide authority or safety misconceptions; evidence must record answers and limitations.

reasons: P0 comprehension and safety-boundary claims require strict evidence.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized sequential completion of all Work Items; this WI records bounded evidence and preserves explicit limits.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before implementation and finish.

acceptance: Record the six-question comprehension protocol for English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese with per-language answers, score, and misconception review.
Verify each P0 language route reaches the North Star, purpose, architecture, boundaries, decisions, adoption, and recovery pages without silent fallback.
Run focused structural tests plus all declared documentation, multilingual, AI, and strict quality checks; record any editorial-quality limitation explicitly.
Update capability and multilingual evidence only to the bounded level supported by the recorded review; do not claim native editorial quality without independent native review.
guidelines: Use the six-question protocol and record evidence rather than asserting that documentation is easy to understand.
Treat five correct answers and zero critical misconceptions as the protocol threshold; preserve any language-specific limitation.
Keep authority, security, verification, and human-control boundaries explicit in every language.
Do not modify runtime behavior, release metadata, or P1/P2 translation ownership.

intent.problem: WI-5 closes the trilingual P0 route, but file presence and automated parity do not prove that a non-technical reader understands the project or avoids unsafe authority and security assumptions.
constraints: Run a bounded desk-review protocol in all three languages and record answers as evidence.
Do not invent independent native-language human review or upgrade claims beyond evidence.
intent.rationale: The documentation initiative succeeds only when comprehension is tested as a scenario with explicit limits, not inferred from translation count or readability.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A non-technical reader follows each localized home and answers the six core project-understanding questions.
scenarioCoverage.expected: At least five answers are correct in each language and no authority, security, verification, or human-control misconception appears.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record per-language answers and score in the three comprehension review evidence pages; enforce route and threshold tests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A reader encounters a stop or security boundary and identifies the safe human decision and external control owner.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The reader does not treat Unknown as permission, governance as a sandbox, or an agent explanation as proof.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Check evidence pages for stop/security answers and run structural semantic-boundary tests.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: No restricted governance paths are changed.

rollbackNote: Revert this evidence and test-only Work Item diff.
